summary: Venture Global, Inc. filed an 8-K at VGCP subsidiary regarding an issuance of $750 million 6.000% senior secured notes due 2036. Proceeds alongside cash and hedge terminations prepaid an existing term loan. The notes were privately placed to QIBs under Rule 144A/Regulation S, secured by collateral shared with existing working capital and senior secured notes. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change occurred. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
